description: Which pods can actually reach which, according to the Kubernetes NetworkPolicies in the manifests you paste (multi-document YAML: Pods/Deployments/StatefulSets…, Services, Namespaces, NetworkPolicies) — computed, not guessed, and checked against netpol-analyzer. Returns the pairs that CAN connect with their ports (everything else is blocked), plus findings: policies or peers that select no pods, the namespaceSelector/podSelector split-list trap, Services selecting no pods or exposing a missing targetPort, missing ConfigMap/Secret/ServiceAccount, unreachable pods, hostNetwork pods. Give `from` and `to` ("namespace/name", or "external") to explain one pair: which policies isolate each side and which rule lets it through. Out of scope: AdminNetworkPolicy, CNI-specific policies, node traffic.
